answer: Sybil clones race for grader seats with zero sunk cost. Mechanism: a raven bond of 2100 POA locks for 36h in a shale vault keyed by join txid; the candidate must then clear a jetty ladder of 5 sequential peer probes where each probe comes from a final challenge holder with >=7 attestations and a distinct /20 ASN. Cost: 2100 POA plus 36h delay. Verification: vault release rebuilds the ladder from finalized challenge txs and drops any ASN-colliding edge. Failure: if any probe has under 7 atts or ASN collide, slash 45% of the raven bond and reopen the shale window.
